metadata.title: A Seifert Dichotomy for Z2-Harmonic One-Forms
metadata.abstract: We establish a dichotomy for Z/2-harmonic one-forms on Seifert fibered rational homology three-spheres. For an oriented base with at most three exceptional fibers, we prove nonexistence along any fixed connection-metric family when the fibers are sufficiently collapsed. With at least four exceptional fibers, existing results give existence for every Riemannian metric. We also complete the corresponding classification for nonorientable bases.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 按 Seifert 基底例外纤维数，给出有理同调三球上 Z₂ 调和一形式的存在性分界。
analysis.breakthrough: 至多三例外纤维时沿固定族充分塌缩可排除存在，至少四时结合已有结果得全度量存在。
analysis.limitations: 前半是固定连接度量族的塌缩结论，不是该拓扑类型所有度量均不存在。 已补读引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 声明 GPT-5.6 Sol 发展证明并生成初稿，随后由作者修改；自动 LLM 审阅不是形式化证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 塌缩与调和场的联系值得关注。
